topic: Need for simple oxygen system and pressurized cabin effect of lack of o2, Types of 02 regulators
syllabus_extract: Need for simple oxygen system and pressurized cabin effect of lack of o2, Types of 02 regulators. Fire detection and protection system:
specific_objectives: 23.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the need of oxygen systems, types of systems, working principles of components.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of demand regulator operation; Safety: Do not breathe directly from regulator; Instructor supervision required
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an aircraft oxygen system?
How does cabin pressure change with altitude?
What are the symptoms of hypoxia in crew members?

development.content:
Physiological effects of hypoxia
Need for simple oxygen systems
Pressurized cabin effects
Oxygen system types overview

Working principle of demand regulators
Continuous flow regulator operation
Comparison of regulator types
Safety features in regulators

Maintenance requirements for regulators
Troubleshooting common regulator faults
Regulator selection criteria
Integration with fire protection systems

summary_questions: Explain the difference between demand and continuous flow regulators.
Describe the effect of lack of oxygen at high altitudes.
List three safety features found in modern oxygen regulators.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the oxygen system requirements change for LP 02 (Fire detection and protection system) integration.

pft_rows.syllabus: Types of fire zone classification of a/c, detection system requirements, types of detection system, types of detectors, extinguishing agents and systems
